author: blu
body: Bridge between the game engine and the Helm communication platform. Maps engine entities to Helm player slots, translates game events (kills, objectives, phase changes) to Helm voice/chat events, and drives the Helm voice hierarchy rank assignments from game roles.

author: reek
body: The engine produces HelmEvents. The Helm app consumes them to update its River (chat clustering) and Bridge (voice hierarchy). This decouples the engine from Helm's UI -- the engine does not import Helm types directly.
